name: Burning Mountain
source:
You know in older adventure style games where you reach a prompt that says you cant do that. Well this game is kinda like that. If you played zelda your essentially playing as the navi of this game. A rail road experience that ramps up in adventure and excitement as this hero goes to accomplish his quest. You may aid him, you may advise him, but regardless of what you say or dont say. He will be marching forward like the hero he is.

A interactive story with ramping excitement, heavy emphasis on emotion, and simplistic gameplay.

[From [url=https://plasmastarfish.itch.io/burning-mountain] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你知道，在较早的冒险风格游戏中，你会收到提示说你不能这样做。嗯，这个游戏有点像那样。如果你玩过《塞尔达》，那么你基本上就是在扮演这个游戏的导航者。当这位英雄去完成他的任务时，铁路体验将充满冒险和兴奋。你可以帮助他，你可以建议他，但无论你说什么或不说什么。他将像英雄一样勇往直前。

一个互动故事，充满刺激，高度重视情感，游戏玩法简单。

[来自[url=https://plasmastarfish.itch.io/burning-mountain] itch.io[/url]]
